title: Floating Head Over Parisian Street
description: A surreal painting depicts a giant disembodied bald head with wide eyes and open mouth floating above a colorful cobblestone street. Two silhouetted figures walk toward it while bright pink laser-like beams radiate from the head across the scene.
prompt: Surreal vibrant street scene in Paris with cobblestone path lined by colorful buildings with flower boxes and awnings. A giant disembodied pale bald human head with wide eyes and open mouth floats in the sky above two walking silhouetted figures. Bright pink laser beams shoot out from the head in all directions. In the background is the green dome of Sacre Coeur under a dramatic red and blue sunset sky with a large stylized yellow sun. Cartoonish illustrative style with bold outlines.
